# Monthly net excise tax receipts for FY 2018 (in millions)
# From the table on page 18, column "Excise taxes con. Net excise taxes (35)"
monthly_data = [
    7463,  # Oct 2017
    7240,  # Nov 2017
    6867,  # Dec 2017
    6168,  # Jan 2018
    5878,  # Feb 2018
    7849,  # Mar 2018
    6905,  # Apr 2018
    7325,  # May 2018
    7343,  # June 2018
    7716,  # July 2018
    8154,  # Aug 2018
    16079  # Sept 2018
]

print("Monthly Net Excise Tax Receipts (FY 2018) - in millions:")
for i, val in enumerate(monthly_data):
    print(f"  Month {i+1}: {val}")

# Calculate mean
mean = sum(monthly_data) / len(monthly_data)
print(f"\nMean: {mean}")

# Calculate absolute deviations
abs_deviations = [abs(x - mean) for x in monthly_data]
print("\nAbsolute Deviations from Mean:")
for i, dev in enumerate(abs_deviations):
    print(f"  Month {i+1}: {dev:.3f}")

# Calculate MAD (Mean Absolute Deviation)
mad = sum(abs_deviations) / len(abs_deviations)
print(f"\nMean Absolute Deviation (MAD): {mad:.3f} millions")
print(f"Rounded to thousandths: {mad:.3f}")
